title: A single molecule magnet to single molecule magnet transformation via a solvothermal process: Fe4Dy2 → Fe6Dy3

material_class.structural_family: Fe4Ln2 coordination cluster with mdea2- and m-nitrobenzoate

synthesis.procedure: A solution of [Fe3O(m-NO2C6H4COO)6(H2O)3]·(m-NO2C6H4COO) (0.164 g, 0.12 mmol), Y(NO3)3·6H2O (0.048 g, 0.13 mmol) and mdeaH2 (0.121 g, 0.10 mmol) in MeCN (30 ml) was stirred at room temperature for one hour under aerobic conditions. The clear brown solution was left undisturbed. After one day, yellow crystals were collected, washed with MeCN and dried in air.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: undisturbed crystallization; yellow crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility (1.8–300 K, 1000 Oe) is below the spin-only value for four HS Fe(III) ions and decreases continuously on cooling, indicating antiferromagnetic Fe–Fe coupling. Fitting H = −2J·S1·S2 gave g* = 2.03 and J = −7.04 cm−1 (magnetostructural estimate J = −10.3 cm−1). Magnetization at 2 K reaches only 0.05 μB at 70 kOe. No out-of-phase ac signal above 1.8 K; not an SMM.

measurements.name: χT vs T
measurements.value: decreases continuously to 1.8 K; 300 K value below spin-only for 4 Fe(III)

measurements.name: exchange coupling J (Fe–Fe)
measurements.conditions: fit of χT vs T; H = −2J·S1·S2; g* = 2.03

source_locations.location: Experimental, CCDC 1429780 and 1429781; structure of 1 deposited

material_class.structural_family: Fe4Ln2 coordination cluster with mdea2- and m-nitrobenzoate (isomorphous with 1)

synthesis.procedure: Prepared by the same aerobic procedure as 1, replacing Y(NO3)3·6H2O with Dy(NO3)3·6H2O. A solution of [Fe3O(m-NO2C6H4COO)6(H2O)3]·(m-NO2C6H4COO) (0.164 g, 0.12 mmol), Dy(NO3)3·6H2O and mdeaH2 (0.121 g, 0.10 mmol) in MeCN (30 ml) was stirred at room temperature for one hour and left undisturbed to crystallize.

reagents.name: dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate
reagents.amount: in place of Y(NO3)3·6H2O (0.048 g, 0.13 mmol scale of 1)

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: crystals collected analogously to 1; washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: SMM. χT decreases on cooling to a minimum at 12 K then rises to 32.6 cm3 K mol-1 at 1.8 K; subtracting 1 indicates weakly ferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling. Magnetization reaches ~12 μB without saturation at 70 kOe. Zero-field ac data show frequency-dependent χ'/χ''; Arrhenius fit Ueff = 7.1 K, τ0 = 6.4×10-6 s (α = 0.05–0.16). Under 500 Oe dc, Ueff = 18.4 K and τ0 = 2.0×10-7 s.

measurements.name: magnetization
measurements.conditions: 2, 3 and 5 K; ~12 μB without saturation at 70 kOe

measurements.name: Ueff
measurements.conditions: zero dc field; Arrhenius fit of frequency-dependent ac data

measurements.name: Cole-Cole α
measurements.conditions: generalised Debye fit, zero dc field

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of 1 (0.020 g, 0.01 mmol) in MeCN (2 mL) was sealed in a 10 mL Biotage Microwave Reaction Kit and kept at 120 °C for 72 h under conventional solvothermal (not microwave) conditions. After cooling, brown crystals were collected, washed with MeCN and dried in air.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal in 10 mL Biotage microwave vial in oven (not microwave heating)
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: after cooling, brown crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: χT at 300 K is well below the value for six HS Fe(III) ions and decreases continuously to 0.75 cm3 K mol-1 at 1.8 K, indicating strong antiferromagnetic Fe–Fe coupling in the Fe5 pentamer and to the unique Fe. No out-of-phase ac signal above 1.8 K.

measurements.name: χT
measurements.conditions: 1.8 K, 1000 Oe; 300 K value also much lower than spin-only

material_class.structural_family: Fe6Ln3 oxo cluster with {FeDy3(μ4-O)} tetrahedron and Dy3 triangle

synthesis.procedure: Obtained by the same solvothermal procedure as 3, using 2 in place of 1: cluster 2 in MeCN (2 mL) sealed in a 10 mL Biotage vial and heated at 120 °C for 72 h (oven, not microwave). After cooling, crystals were collected, washed with MeCN and dried in air.

reagents.name: compound 2
reagents.amount: same scale as 3 (0.020 g, 0.01 mmol of 1)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solvothermal in 10 mL Biotage microwave vial in oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: after cooling, crystals washed with MeCN and dried in air

properties.summary: SMM. Strong AF coupling: 300 K χT much below six Fe(III) plus three Dy(III); χT decreases to 1.8 K. Subtracting 3 indicates weakly antiferromagnetic Dy–Dy coupling; χT(4)−χT(3) at 300 K is 42.7 vs 42.5 cm3 K mol-1 expected for three Dy(III). Magnetization shows an inflection near 10 kOe; Magellan axes on the Dy3 triangle give a magnetic (not non-magnetic) ground state. Out-of-phase ac signals confirm SMM behaviour.

measurements.name: χT vs T
measurements.value: decreases continuously 300–1.8 K; 300 K far below spin-only
